newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan paper says prosecutors questioned Hamanaka.
newsitem.headline: Japan paper says prosecutors questioned Hamanaka.

text.p: Tokyo prosecutors have apparently questioned Sumitomo Corp's former star copper trader Yasuo Hamanaka in their investigation of the trade house's huge copper trading losses, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.
Without citing any sources, the evening edition of the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun also said that Sumitomo may press criminal charges against Hamanaka as early as this month.
The paper said the questioning apparently took place on or before October 2 but gave no indication as to what questions were asked.

Sumitomo announced last month that it intended to press charges against Hamanaka, who it blames for running up losses estimated at $2.6 billion from unauthorised copper trades. Sumitomo fired Hamanaka in June. He has not commented on the losses.
